## Use case

Required. State what the part must do and how it will be used.

## Constraints

Required. List material assumptions, printer limits, mounting rules, load expectations, and any no-go geometry.

## Key dimensions

Required. Record the controlling dimensions or size envelope.

## Preferred task mode

Required. Confirm `original_product_design`.

## Notes

Optional. Add sketches, photos, similar parts, or manufacturing preferences.
